headline: Is Mexico ready to make the leap to digital payments? Financial inclusion, one of the challenges
summary: Mexico has the infrastructure needed to gradually reduce its reliance on cash and shift to digital payments. Limited financial inclusion is one of the structural challenges.
why: Digital payment adoption affects banks, fintech firms and payment networks by shifting transaction volumes away from cash. Financial inclusion determines how far that market can grow.
original_headline: ¿México está listo para dar el salto a pagos digitales? Inclusión financiera, uno de los desafíos
